quiz.intro: Choose whether each of the five statements is true or false. An explanation appears after you choose. Your answers remain only on this screen.
quiz.q.label: Question {i}
quiz.q1: After losing several times in a row, the next round is more likely to be a win.
quiz.q1.exp: Each round is decided with the same probability, regardless of the rounds before it. The machine does not remember earlier results. This belief is called the gambler's fallacy.
quiz.q1.me: The longest losing streak in this session was {n} rounds. The probability of the next round did not change.
quiz.q2: After a loss, doubling your bet will eventually recover the losses.
quiz.q2.exp: Changing the betting method does not change the expected value of each round. Doubling each time reaches your balance or the betting limit first during the rare long losing stretch. The simulation section shows this directly.
quiz.q2.me: In this session you raised your bet right after a loss {n} times.
quiz.q3: A round where the reels stopped one symbol short, a near miss, means you have come close to a win.
quiz.q3.exp: The result is decided before the screen is shown. A pattern that looks one symbol short is only a way of displaying it, and it has no bearing on the probability of the next round.
quiz.q3.me: In this session, {n} rounds looked like near misses.
quiz.q4: If there has been no win for a long time, or an anticipation effect appeared, the machine is due to pay out.
quiz.q4.exp: The timing of a win is not set by the machine in sequence; each round is decided by a random number. An anticipation effect may be a display added after the result has already been decided.
quiz.q4.me: In this session the omen appeared {n} times. At each of those moments, the bonus amount had already been decided.
quiz.q5: If you use a good strategy, you can win money the longer you play.
quiz.q5.exp: A strategy can change how fast losses happen, but it cannot make the expected value positive. As the amount wagered grows, the expected loss grows with it.
quiz.q5.me: The {wagered} credits wagered in this session carry an expected loss of about {loss} credits. This was calculated from each game's return rate.
quiz.wrong: That is not the correct answer.
